metrics.precision: Fraction of emitted verses that were expected.
metrics.exactSetAcc: Deduped emitted set exactly matches expected set; order ignored.
metrics.orderedSeqAcc: Deduped emitted sequence exactly equals expected ordered sequence.
metrics.falseVisibleJumps: Candidate or commit changed to a non-nearby non-expected verse.
metrics.timeToFirstCorrectCandidate: Seconds until a top verse_candidate contains an expected verse, using 300ms chunks.
